name: CSPC Hunan Jingfeng Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
summary: CSPC Hunan Jingfeng Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells chemical drugs and biological agents in China. The company offers sodium hyaluronate injection for use in orthopedics and surgery applications. It also offers ophthalmic devices and API products, as well as engages in the research and development of antitumor, cancer, and cardiovascular drugs; and distributed in the fields of cardiovascular disease, orthopedic pain disease, tumor disease, women and children. The company was formerly known as Hunan Jingfeng Pharmaceutical Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to CSPC Hunan Jingfeng Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. in April 2026. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Changde…
